summary: The exterior assembly is visually coherent, but the required internal component interfaces and power-button routing are not verifiable from the committed exterior views.

checks.description: The visible enclosure shell, top, feet, ventilation, and framed apertures form a coherent assembly with no obvious collision, floating part, or missing exterior structure.

evidence.description: The isometric view visibly shows an aligned, continuous exterior enclosure with seated feet and no obvious detached or colliding exterior part.

checks.description: The views do not expose a 170 x 170 mm Mini-ITX mounting pattern, board retention features, a board envelope, or its rear-I/O relationship.

evidence.description: The isometric exterior view does not visibly show the motherboard tray, Mini-ITX standoffs, a board envelope, or rear-I/O engagement.

checks.description: Side ventilation is visible, but the AXP120-X67 envelope and its gap to the panel are not shown, so fit and intake clearance cannot be established.

evidence.description: The image visibly shows a perforated side panel but no cooler envelope or clearance gap.

checks.description: The committed views do not identify the compact-GPU envelope, I/O-bracket retention, PCIe-riser path, or power-cable bend space.

evidence.description: The front view shows exterior apertures but no identifiable GPU, bracket engagement, riser route, or cable-clearance volume.

checks.description: The 160 x 80 x 40 mm PSU envelope, retention, AC inlet access, airflow path, and cable routing are not visible.

evidence.description: The exterior orthographic view does not expose the behind-tray PSU volume or identify PSU retention, inlet, airflow, or routing features.

checks.description: No installed external power button is identifiable, and an internal route to the motherboard header is not exposed.

evidence.description: The exterior view contains holes and apertures, but none is visibly identifiable as an installed power-button actuator and no internal lead path is shown.
